pack073.title: Realtime Voice
pack073.objective: Implement low-latency realtime voice sessions with interruption/barge-in, microphone permission indicator, STOP, transcript, usage aggregation and retention policy.
pack073.acceptance: Realtime session starts/stops cleanly and cannot leave microphone/provider stream running silently.
hard_rules: Microphone access requires explicit visible permission and active capture indication.
Global STOP must terminate microphone capture, provider/session streaming and pending speech output promptly.
Barge-in/interruption must stop current assistant speech without creating duplicate billing or orphaned streams.
Realtime transcript and usage remain owner-scoped and follow configured retention policy.
Unknown realtime provider pricing or session accounting blocks paid execution.
Training permission remains independent from microphone/session and transcript permissions.
